extraction_warnings: PDF source uses 8-digit codes without dots (e.g., '33011200') and 6-digit subheading codes without dots (e.g., '330119'). Normalized to NNNN.NN.NN format (e.g., '3301.12.00') and NNNN.NN format (e.g., '3301.19') per project schema.

PDF table-chrome headers ('Main Notes', 'Sl.No. Notes Notification Date Notification No', 'Product Description and Export Policy', 'Itc(hs) Code. Description Export Policy Policy Condition') were recognized as table chrome and EXCLUDED from the legal notes per extraction rules.
Section VI 'Main Notes' (4 notes) are attributed to section_notes (Section VI, Products of the Chemical or Allied Industries), not chapter_notes. These are identical to those of Chapter 28/30 etc.

Many subheadings in heading 3301 (e.g., 3301.29, 3301.30, 3301.90) contain very long compound descriptions where multiple distinct products are listed (e.g., 'Anise oil; Cajeput oil; Cananga oil; Caraway oil; Cassia oil; Cedarwood oil; Cinnamon bark oil; Cinnamon leaf oil') and the individual tariff line is identified by a ': ---- <product name>' suffix. These compound descriptions are preserved verbatim as they appear in the PDF.

Tariff line 3301.30.10 (Agar oil) has a Restricted export policy with an extensive Policy Condition (Notification 52/2024-25 dated 20.01.2025) covering annual export limits of 7,050 Kg per annum for Agar Oil from Aquilaria Malaccensis from artificially propagated sources, requiring Certificate of Origin from Forest Department, CITES permit, etc. Captured verbatim in policy_conditions metadata.
Tariff line 3301.29.37 (Sandalwood oil) has a Restricted export policy under Notification 15/2015-20 dated 05.07.2017. Captured in policy_conditions metadata.
PDF source has typo 'Fennugreek' (instead of 'Fenugreek') in subheading 3301.90 tariff lines (3301.90.11 through 3301.90.17). Preserved verbatim from source.
Subheading 3301.25 in PDF reads 'Essential oils other than those of citrus fruit : -- Of other mints' — preserved verbatim including hyphen-prefix indicators ('--') from WCO HS nomenclature.

Heading 3303 in PDF lists tariff lines as '33030010', '33030020', etc. The intermediate subheading is shown as '330300' ('Perfumes and toilet waters:'). Normalized as subheading 3303.00 with tariff lines 3303.00.10 through 3303.00.90.
Subheading 3304.91 PDF description reads 'Other : -- Powders, whether or not compressed' — colon and hyphen-prefix indicators preserved verbatim.

Heading 3307 tariff line 3307.41.00 description spans multiple lines: 'preparations for perfuming or deodorizing rooms, including odoriferous preparations used during religious rites : -- Agarbatti and other odoriferous preparations which operate by burning' — concatenated verbatim from PDF.

The 'Export Policy' and 'Policy Condition' columns are not part of the tariff line description field; they are captured separately. Unit-of-measure column (kg/u/etc) is NOT shown in this chapter's PDF — unit field set to null for all tariff lines.

Source PDF Note 4 (chapter note) text includes 'scented sachets; odoriferous preparations which operate by burning; perfumed papers and papers impregnated or coated with cosmetics; contact lens or artificial eye solution; wadding, felt and nonwovens, impregnated, coated or covered with perfume or cosmetics; animal toilet preparations.' — preserved verbatim including missing space after colon ('preparations:scented sachets').

chapter_notes.text: This Chapter does not cover: (a) natural oleoresins or vegetable extracts of heading 1301 or 1302; (b) soap or other products of heading 3401; or (c) gum, wood or sulphate turpentine or other products of heading 3805.
The expression "odoriferous substances" in heading 3302 refers only to the substances of heading 3301, to odoriferous constituents isolated from those substances or to synthetic aromatics.

Headings 3303 to 3307 apply, inter alia, to products, whether or not mixed (other than aqueous distillates and aqueous solutions of essential oils), suitable for use as goods of these headings and put up in packings of a kind sold by retail for such use.

The expression "perfumery, cosmetic or toilet preparations" in heading 3307 applies, inter alia, to the following products:scented sachets; odoriferous preparations which operate by burning; perfumed papers and papers impregnated or coated with cosmetics; contact lens or artificial eye solution; wadding, felt and nonwovens, impregnated, coated or covered with perfume or cosmetics; animal toilet preparations.

section_notes.text: (A) Goods (other than radioactive ores) answering to a description in heading 2844 or 2845 are to be classified in those headings and in no other heading of this Schedule. (B) Subject to paragraph (A) above, goods answering to a description in heading 2843, 2846 or 2852 are to be classified in those headings and in no other heading of this Section.

Subject to Note 1 above, goods classifiable in heading 3004, 3005, 3006, 3212, 3303, 3304, 3305, 3306, 3307, 3506, 3707 or 3808 by reason of being put up in measured doses or for retail sale are to be classified in those headings and in no other heading of this Schedule.

Goods put up in sets consisting of two or more separate constituents,some or all of which fall in this Section and are intended to be mixed together to obtain a product of Section VI or VII, are to be classified in the heading appropriate to that product, provided that the constituents are: (a) having regard to the manner in which they are put up, clearly identifiable as being intended to be used together without first being repacked; (b) presented together; and (c) identifiable, whether by their nature or by the relative proportions in which they are present, as being complementary one to another.

Where a product answers to a description in one or more of the headings in Section VI by virtue of being described by name or function and also to heading 3827, then it is classifiable in a heading that references the product by name or function and not under heading 3827.
